preview.title: Justine Moore (@venturetwins)
preview.description:
Over the last year and a half, I've tried this Turing test prompt on every AI video model.
Shockingly, none have succeeded - until today.
Congrats to the @Hailuo_AI team on MiniMax 3, which can officially write "Hi" on a chalkboard.
And it's open source!…

gholam.text: رفیق، بالاخره طلسم نوشتن متن تو ویدیوهای هوش مصنوعی شکست! مدل جدید MiniMax 3 تونسته آزمون سخت نوشتن «Hi» رو روی تخته‌سیاه پاس کنه، تازشم اوپن‌سورسه.

links.text:
Over the last year and a half, I've tried this Turing test prompt on every AI video model.

Shockingly, none have succeeded - until today. 

Congrats to the @Hailuo_AI team on MiniMax 3, which can officially write "Hi" on a chalkboard.

And it's open source!

quote.text:
I think I've uncovered the next Turing test for AI video: writing.

I've tried this prompt dozens of times on every model: "man writes 'hi' in chalk on blackboard"

None can do it. Veo 2 (below) gets the closest. It's actually frustrating to watch!
